description: Cal Plus is an AI calorie tracker and coach. Connect your Cal Plus account and ask ChatGPT about your own logged data in plain words: how your nutrition has been over any period and how it compares with your calorie, protein, carb and fat targets; what you ate on a given day; when you last logged a particular food; your step count and active energy from a connected health app; workout frequency, volume and consistency; your body-weight trend against your goal; habit streaks; and the dietary restrictions, allergies and preferences you have asked Cal Plus to remember, so suggestions respect them. Requires an active Cal Plus subscription.

defaultPrompt: How has my nutrition been over the last month, and what's the one thing I should change?
